messages:
Nora M.: Ferris Dynamics (FD-741) INV-2026-0128 is 38 days past due. Total $9,750. No partials posted. Sent dunning #2 yesterday, no answer.

Sam K.: Any active support issues that would justify a hold?

Priya (Billing): No product holds. Usage looks normal: monthly plan $9,000 + small overage $750. Bank hasn't reported returns.

Sam K.: I spoke with their finance lead Ana — payroll timing messed them up. Asking for a 2-payment split over 30 days and to move ACH window because of a local bank holiday.

Nora M.: Policy: need 50% upfront for 2-way splits. We can approve 50/50 if they provide wire/ACH confirmation within 5 business days. No fee waivers without manager sign-off.

Priya (Billing): If they agree, I'll set invoice status to "payment-plan-proposed", disable auto-suspend until first payment clears, and add ledger note.

Sam K.: I'll send the agreement and cc legal@redwood. Requesting PO number and bank remittance details.

LegalBot: [auto] Template payment agreement attached in reply. Include clause: "proof of initiation (confirmation or trace) required within 5 business days; funds must clear in 10 days or plan void."

CollectionsBot: [auto] Dunning #2 sent to accounting@ferris.ai (2026-04-12T15:03:10Z). Next reminder scheduled 2026-04-19T09:00:00Z.

Nora M.: Good. Marking check-in for 2026-04-19. If no proof+payment, escalate to legal and prepare service suspension notice.
